text:
maria: FYI, hitting a weird failure in the samplekit where tool-call responses with structured schemas break when an auth retry happens during streaming

sam: ugh, can you paste the minimal repro? which SDK?

maria: node SDK, json-mode streaming + schema validation. sequence is: request -> auth 401 -> sdk retries -> stream resumes but parser throws on the next object (looks like a partial buffer boundary)

jon: that sounds like a deferred-parse boundary issue. streaming parser expects a complete JSON object per chunk but retry inserts partial bytes?

maria: exact. stack: 
```
Error: Unexpected end of JSON input
 at JSON.parse (<anonymous>)
 at parseToolPayload (/node_modules/redwood-sdk/jsonmode.js:312:22)
 at resumeStream (/node_modules/redwood-sdk/stream.js:101:14)
```

lee: does the SDK re-wrap the stream on retry or create a new stream instance? if it re-wraps, the parser state might not reset and gets a concat of two adjacent chunks

sam: inspecting code now — node-sdk calls .resume() on the old stream if token refresh succeeds. Go-sdk opens a fresh stream. parity bug territory.

maria: right — go-sdk worked fine. our onboarding sample app is Node-first so customers hit it during trials and it's confusing.

deploy-bot: deploy completed: samplekit/stable @ prod (rev 2026-03-22-14) :rocket:

jon: short-term workaround: fallback to non-streaming jsonmode for the sample app or enable a "resetOnRetry" flag to recreate parser state when an auth retry occurs.

lee: long-term fix: make stream parser idempotent across retries — either buffer until full object or use a framing protocol (length-prefix) from the runtime. framing would avoid boundary ambiguity.

sam: I'm going to open two things: (1) node-sdk bug to recreate parser on retry, (2) samplekit PR with an opt-in config flag `jsonMode.streaming = false` and docs note.

maria: thanks. can we also add a quick smoke test to devex CI that simulates an auth retry mid-stream? that'll catch regressions.

sam: yes. test plan draft: spawn a fake runtime that sends a partial object, then triggers 401, then resumes with the remainder. assert SDK either fails gracefully with a clear error or reconstructs the object.

jon: one more note — schema validation currently runs eagerly on each object chunk. that makes error messages noisy. maybe delay validation until object fully parsed or include a schema-validation context so we can map errors back to user-friendly hints like "likely truncated stream after auth retry".

lee: agreed. I'll sketch an RFC for parser state machine + validation hooks. hoping to land after the SDK patch.

maria: filing the samplekit PR now, linking the SDK issue in the description. will ping when ready for review.

sam: documented issue created: RDW-4821 (node-sdk stream parser retry parity). tagging @eng-runtime for framing discussion.

maria: thanks all. really appreciate the quick cycle on this — this one was causing onboarding calls to take extra time. :pray:
